alternatives_considered.approach: Drive the activity filter with the client SegmentedControl island instead of the server GET chip form.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The filter must live in the URL so it survives reload, shared links and the retry after a failed load; the GET form works before JavaScript arrives and already carries the sibling expense filter through hidden inputs, which a client control would have to reimplement.

alternatives_considered.approach: Keep updateProfile's redirect-on-refusal and preserve failed profile input with a sessionStorage draft restore in the new island.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It preserves a transport that contradicts the house rule (conventions.md: refusals go inline; redirects are for success) and trades a documented pattern for per-page storage cleverness; the inline refusal keeps the typed state naturally because the form never unmounts.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add feed pagination with a load-more button to satisfy 'failed pages show load-more retry' literally.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The contract face of this issue fixes the activity reads as unchanged, and paging would change the readers both feeds share; the existing section-level retry with the filter preserved is what 'failed pages' maps to without touching the reads.

alternatives_considered.approach: Put the viewer-zone timestamp and its formatter in a new components/timestamp.tsx plus lib/dates/format.ts.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: One caller does not earn two modules; components/ui-interactive.tsx is already the shared home for stateful presentational pieces and its pure helpers are already unit-tested from app/ui-set.test.ts, so the island and its formatter belong there.

alternatives_considered.approach: Key the members roster avatars on displayName so roster and feed tints always agree.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It would break the shared set's documented contract (same member, same colour on every screen and render) and the app/ui-set.test.ts pin that renaming must not recolour; the feed can only be name-keyed because ActivityRow carries no actor id, so the mismatch is disclosed instead of spreading it to the roster.

alternatives_considered.approach: Keep the controlled island and resync its state from the echoed values with a useEffect only (no uncontrolled fields, no key).
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: If the failure is the DOM desync QA observed (hooks held EUR while the DOM painted USD), re-setting identical state issues no re-render and the DOM stays wrong; keyed uncontrolled defaults rebuild the field DOM from the submitted values, which is correct under both the stale-state and the desync mechanism.

alternatives_considered.approach: Convert the island to uncontrolled fields without touching the server action (no echo of submitted values).
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It leaves no Vitest-testable seam: this repo runs Vitest in node with no jsdom, and SSR markup cannot distinguish a controlled value from an uncontrolled defaultValue, so the regression could not be pinned; the echo makes the submitted-values round trip assertable at the action and helper level.

work_order.approach: Make the submitted values, not the saved props, the source of truth after a refusal — the opposite of the previous attempt's 'hold both fields in controlled island state'. updateProfile echoes the exact submitted displayName and currency in state.values on validation failure (additive only; schemas, messages, ?saved=1 and signin redirects unchanged); ProfileFormState gains the optional values plus a pure client-safe profileFormDefaults(state, saved) helper returning the submitted values on a refusal that carries them and the saved values otherwise, with an echoed currency that is not a supported code falling back to saved; ProfileForm becomes uncontrolled (defaultValue from the helper) inside a form keyed by the displayed defaults, so each refusal re-seeds the field DOM from what was actually submitted instead of repainting the saved currency, while idle renders the saved props exactly as today. Inline FieldError and aria wiring, the styled select with its chevron, the ProfileSaveButton pending guard, and the ?saved=1 / ?error=invalid transports are untouched.
assumptions: The attempt-1 tree on sdlc/issue-37 is the base: the shared set, AppShell, tokens, the ProfileForm island, the inline-refusal updateProfile and the Timestamp island already exist; this order revises them, it does not rebuild them.
The contract face still fixes reads and actions; the only action change is additive (values echoed on the validation-failure return), not a rule, schema, message or success-transport change.

With no actor id on ActivityRow the feed avatar tint can only derive from the actor name while the roster stays id-keyed per the avatar contract; the mismatch stays disclosed, the roster is not re-keyed.
'Failed pages show load-more retry' (IAC-4, ui.md Activity partial) is still read as section-level retry with the filter preserved; no pagination is added.
Timestamps are stored UTC and the viewer zone is only knowable on the client; the Timestamp island behaviour is unchanged.
PGlite serves one connection, so the sequential withDb reads stay sequential; no read is parallelised.
sdlc:verify here is typecheck plus test:ci plus build; the work-order lint step does not apply because the repo has no lint script by decision.

The members loading fallback markers (#invite-url, notice params, data-skeleton names, bg-muted/20 with motion-safe:animate-pulse, aria-busy) stay stable because qa/selectors.md and the loading test pin them.

The form key changes only when the displayed defaults change (saved props vs a new refusal's submitted values), so a refusal remounts the fields exactly when there is something new to seed; repeated identical refusals and idle renders do not remount, and focus behaviour is unchanged from attempt 1.
lib/auth/actions.test.ts on the branch already pins the inline-refusal contract; this order adds the echo case to it rather than rewriting it.
work_order.confidence_rationale: The failure is pinned to three lines (value={chosenCurrency}, useState(currency), and an error return without values) and the fix is correct under both candidate mechanisms — stale controlled state and the DOM desync QA observed — because the field DOM is rebuilt from the echoed submission rather than repainted from the saved prop. What keeps it from higher is that the exact React-internal trigger was read from QA evidence plus code rather than a live repro, and the keyed-remount focus behaviour is new.
work_order.debate_summary: The critique was right three times and manufacturing noise twice. Accepted outright: (1) the isBalanceBlockedRefusal bundle defect — value-importing lib/groups/members.ts from a 'use client' island would drag drizzle-orm and the db schema into the browser bundle, so the predicate and sentence now live in client-safe validation.ts with NonZeroBalanceError built from the same constant; (2) the double-owned empty state — EmptyState now has one owner (inside ActivityFeed behind the unchanged emptyText string, new props optional so the group excerpt inherits without an edit); (3) the Card/panel double-h2 — Cards wrap without titles and keep the panels' aria-labelledby h2s. Accepted as disclosure, rejected as a change: the name-keyed feed avatars cannot match the id-keyed roster (ActivityRow carries no actor id and the contract face forbids adding one), so the mismatch is stated in assumptions and the roster is deliberately not re-keyed. Rejected: the blocking demand to escalate the profile transport — redirect-on-refusal contradicts the binding house rule that refusals go inline (ADR-0008, conventions.md) and ui.md's 'failed saves never clear input', while schemas, messages and both success redirects stay byte-identical, so the transport move is inside the ticket, not an amendment of it; the sessionStorage-restore alternative stays rejected. Minor findings (ListRow fit, directionWords helper, styled select, load-more interpretation, assumption wording) were all folded into the work order, and the load-bearing edge cases (archived/disabled invite gating, viewer-perspective wording, hydration/timezone/future-time behaviour, pending guard after refusal, pinned skeleton/notice/selector markers, filtered-vs-truly-empty) are now explicit file constraints or acceptance text.
evidence: T-7 fails only at its final assertion: #profile-currency reads USD (saved) instead of EUR (chosen); every preceding AC-5 check passes — styled select, chevron, no page-level sign-out, Saving guard, ?saved=1 single notice, reload persistence, inline field error with no redirect, aria-invalid, typed name kept (error-context.md).

qa-report BUG-1 repro, always reproducible: fresh account, pick EUR, clear Display name, Save → inline 'Enter a display name' with no redirect, name kept, select reverted to the saved value; reproduced 4/4 with both selectOption and real keyboard-arrow selection, hook state holding EUR while the DOM showed USD.

components/profile-form.tsx on sdlc/issue-37: the select is controlled as value={chosenCurrency} with const [chosenCurrency, setChosenCurrency] = useState(currency) — painted from the saved prop, with no path re-seeding it from the submitted FormData on the refusal render.

lib/auth/actions.ts updateProfile on sdlc/issue-37: the validation-failure return carries status, message and fieldErrors only — the submitted displayName/currency are discarded, so the island has no source for what the user actually chose.
T-7-refusal.png: empty name field with its inline error visible while the currency select shows USD.

files.change: Replace the controlled useState-seeded-from-props fields with uncontrolled inputs: TextInput takes defaultValue={defaults.displayName} and the select takes defaultValue={defaults.currency} where defaults = profileFormDefaults(state, { displayName, currency }), the form carries key={JSON.stringify(defaults)} so a refusal carrying new submitted values re-seeds the field DOM from them instead of repainting the saved currency, and the useState/onChange pair goes away (useActionState stays for errors and pending); keep the FIELD_CLASSES styled select with appearance-none plus ChevronDown, FieldError and aria-invalid/aria-describedby wiring, ProfileSaveButton, noValidate and the single-slot ?saved=1 / legacy ?error=invalid rendering; rewrite the docblock to state the lesson — controlled state seeded from saved props repaints the saved value on refusal and silently discards the choice, so the submitted values echoed by the action are the source of truth after a refusal.
files.why: The file that introduced BUG-1: its controlled select paints the saved prop on the refusal render instead of the submitted choice.

files.change: On profileSchema validation failure, echo the exact submitted strings in the returned state: values: { displayName: field(formData, 'displayName'), currency: field(formData, 'currency') } alongside status, message and fieldErrors; RAW submitted strings (not normalized) so the island restores literally what the user chose; write nothing, keep the ?saved=1 success redirect and the /signin redirect byte-identical.
files.why: The refusal currently drops the submitted values (fieldErrors only), leaving the island no source for the chosen currency.

files.change: Add ProfileFormValues { displayName: string; currency: string }, an optional values?: ProfileFormValues on ProfileFormState, and a pure client-safe profileFormDefaults(state, saved): ProfileFormValues helper returning state.values on an error refusal that carries them (with an echoed currency outside SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES falling back to the saved currency) and saved otherwise; no schema, message or constant change.
files.why: The island and the action need one shared, unit-testable contract for which values a refusal must restore.

out_of_scope: Landing, home, group, expense and settle-up screen markup except what they inherit automatically through the shared ActivityFeed and ui components (new feed props are optional, so app/groups/[id]/page.tsx needs no edit).
Dark mode, explicitly deferred by ui.md.
Any money, authorization, balance, activity or membership rule change: splits, recompute, simplification, guards, feed writers and validation schemas stay as they are.
Feed pagination or load-more: reads stay unchanged per the contract face, so failed loads map to section-level retry.
docs/ui.md, docs/prd.md, docs/trd.md, .sdlc/memory/**, .github/** and .sdlc/** framework paths.
New dependencies: lucide-react and next/font already cover icons and type.
qa_script: Boot the branch build and sign up two users A (owner) and B, plus create a group with expenses, a payment and a placeholder seat.

As A at /groups/<id>/members at 375px and 1280px: roster shows avatars, You/Owner/Placeholder badges, balances in words plus colour, keyboard opens the row overflow disclosure and Remove confirms by naming the member.
Invite panel: copy the link via #invite-url, rotate behind its confirm (new link works, notice shows), disable behind its confirm, then create a fresh link.
Blocked removal: attempt to remove a member with a nonzero balance, read the refusal naming the blocker with a settle-up link; settle up, then remove successfully and read the single status notice.
Claim flow: as B open the invite link, claim the matching placeholder seat, land in the group; open the same seat link again in a second tab and read the taken notice.

Activity at /activity and the group excerpt: all four chips filter correctly, timestamps read relative-then-human in the local zone, expense-edited entries show exactly the changed fields, empty group feed explains itself, filtered-empty keeps its own sentence, failed load keeps the filter on retry.

Profile at /profile: save a new name and currency and read the saved notice; submit an empty name and confirm the input is kept with an inline error; confirm no sign-out control on the page and sign-out works from the account menu by keyboard at 375px.
Keyboard and contrast pass at both widths over all three screens, including the chip row, disclosure, dialogs and the styled currency select; reduced-motion shows no animation.

Regression for BUG-1 at /profile: pick EUR in Default currency, clear Display name, save — the inline name error shows with no redirect, the name field stays empty, #profile-currency still reads EUR; type a name and save again to confirm the retry succeeds once.
residual_risks: The group page excerpt inherits the feed redesign without its owning ticket reviewing it; visually intended, but its QA belongs to the sibling piece.
The details-based overflow disclosure is keyboard-accessible without JavaScript but is not a true ARIA menu; a strict menu-pattern review may ask for a menu island later.

Two identically named placeholder seats are matched by name in the claim flow (existing logic, untouched here): one person must not be able to claim both, and the roster must not read them as one person — flagged for the owning ticket's QA.

A refusal that changes the displayed defaults remounts the profile fields, so focus returns to the body instead of staying in the form; no QA assertion covers post-refusal focus and the inline error plus Tab order still orient the user, but a future pass may move focus to the first error explicitly.
risks: The profile failure transport stays inline (ADR-0008); the page keeps rendering ?error=invalid for direct hits and ?saved=1 is untouched, but a replay walk for a failed save must assert the inline node plus the preserved select value instead of the legacy URL.

updateProfile's error state gains an additive values member; any exhaustive matcher on the state shape (tests, future callers) must tolerate the new key — the grep shows only the profile island and its tests consume it.

The form key is JSON of the displayed displayName/currency; attacker-chosen strings are safe inside a key, and the key changes only when the displayed defaults change, so idle renders and repeated identical refusals never remount.

An echoed currency outside SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES (only reachable by forged POST, since the dropdown offers exactly the supported codes) falls back to the saved currency in the helper; the field error still names the valid choices. No pattern in .sdlc/memory/patterns covers the seeded-controlled-select shape; the Librarian may want one.
work_order.root_cause: components/profile-form.tsx binds the currency select to useState initialized from the saved currency prop, a second source of truth beside the submitted FormData, and nothing re-seeds it from what was actually submitted — so the inline-refusal render repaints the select from the saved value (USD) and silently discards the chosen one (EUR). lib/auth/actions.ts updateProfile compounds it by returning fieldErrors only on validation failure, dropping the submitted values that would let the island recover. The previous diagnosis ('controlled island state naturally preserves both fields because the form never unmounts') is rejected by T-7: the identically-wired name field survived while the select did not.

cases: refused profile save echoes the submitted values: empty displayName plus EUR returns status error naming displayName only with values { displayName: '', currency: 'EUR' } and writes nothing (fails before: values is undefined)
answers a currency it cannot render with field errors instead of a redirect (existing case kept)
names the display name field when the name is the empty one (existing case kept)
writes the display name and currency for the signed-in user only (existing case kept)
sends a caller with no session to sign in rather than updating anything (existing case kept)
profileFormDefaults returns the saved values when the state is idle
profileFormDefaults returns the submitted values on a refusal that carries them, so a chosen EUR survives an empty-name refusal
profileFormDefaults falls back to the saved currency when the echoed value is not a supported code
profileFormDefaults falls back to the saved values on a refusal without values

work_order.understanding: QA failed PR #44 (attempt 1) on T-7/BUG-1, the only failing test in the slice: a failed profile save keeps the typed display name but reverts the currency select to the saved value (USD) instead of the chosen one (EUR), blocking AC-5. The previous work order's diagnosis was WRONG: it claimed the controlled island holding both fields in useState 'keeps the typed state naturally because the form never unmounts'. That premise holds for the text input and fails for the select — the select is bound to useState seeded from the saved currency prop, a second source of truth beside the submitted FormData, and nothing re-seeds it from what was actually submitted, so the refusal render paints the saved value and the choice is silently discarded (QA verified hook state holding EUR while the DOM showed USD). The server side shares the blame: updateProfile returns only fieldErrors on refusal, dropping the submitted values. Everything else in the slice passed twice with zero unfiltered console errors, so the rest of the plan stands and this order changes only the profile refusal round trip.
unknowns: Whether the React-internal trigger is stale controlled state at submit time or a DOM desync after it; the fix (DOM rebuilt from echoed submissions) is correct under both, so the distinction does not change the work.
Whether QA wants the selectors.md profile-error walk extended to assert the preserved select value, which AC-8 now requires.
Whether the sibling group-page ticket wants its own pass over the excerpt once it inherits the redesigned feed rows.

issue_snapshot.title: Members, activity and profile plus display and accessibility sweep
issue_snapshot.body:
Inviting, rostering, following what changed, and editing a profile all look like the same product, with money, dates, and states reading consistently everywhere.

UI face: owner manages roster and invites, everyone reads a filterable human-dated activity feed, and the user edits name plus default currency on one card, with consistent money, date, and state treatment everywhere. Contract face: consumes shell, rows, avatars, badges, dialogs, and skeletons from piece 1; uses the existing membership, invite, activity, and profile reads and actions unchanged. Follows docs/ui.md Members and invite, Activity, and Profile structures plus the Money display, Errors, Skeletons, Empty states, and Accessibility patterns exactly.

**Out of scope**
- Any membership, invite-token, activity-writing, or profile logic change
- Landing, home, group, expense, and settle-up screens (sibling pieces)
- Dark mode, which ui.md explicitly defers

Covers: TR-11, S-8
Part of #31.
Depends on #33.

## Acceptance (from the split)
- **IAC-1** MEMBERS: roster rows show avatar, name, You, Owner, and Placeholder badges with per-member balance in words plus colour, overflow menus for owner actions, and an invite-link panel with copy button, disable and rotate behind confirms.
- **IAC-2** MEMBERS: claiming a matching placeholder on join prompts correctly; empty group prompts sharing the invite link with a copy button; invite rotation failure keeps the old link active and says so; balance-blocked removal names the blocker and points at settle-up.
- **IAC-3** ACTIVITY: feed shows chronological rows with actor avatar, plain-sentence action, relative-then-human timestamp in the viewer zone, and link-through; filter segmented control or scroll chip row covers all, expenses, payments, and members; expense-edited entries summarise exactly the changed fields.
- **IAC-4** ACTIVITY: empty feed explains it fills as the group acts; loading shows skeleton event rows; failed pages show load-more retry; feed error shows retry with filter selection preserved.
- **IAC-5** PROFILE: single settings card shows display name and styled default-currency select with Save and pending guard; sign-out lives in the account menu, never as a red button; failed save keeps input and offers retry.
- **IAC-6** GLOBAL SWEEP: zero balances are neutral everywhere, direction is always words plus colour, dates read as people say them with times in the viewer zone, and every screen in this piece has designed empty, loading, and error states at 375px and 1280px meeting the ui.md accessibility rules and checklists.

## Decisions (recorded by the pipeline)

- **replan-project** by @Shivam-Fl (2026-10-05T17:15:00.755Z):
  Redesign the user interface only; keep the stack, data model, money rules, TRs and every other decision exactly as they are. Rewrite docs/ui.md into a complete, professional design system for the product this issue describes, following the project's frontend-design and ux skills: the full token set (neutral ramp, surfaces, accent, owed/lent/danger with tints, a type scale, the spacing scale extended where layouts need it, radius, elevation), the font loaded with next/font, one icon set named as a dependency, the shared component specs (buttons, inputs including money inputs, segmented control, list rows, cards, avatars, badges, dialogs and bottom sheets, toasts, skeletons, empty states), the app shell and navigation, and each screen's structure as this issue lays it out (landing, auth, home, group page with sections, expense editor, settle-up flow, members and invite, activity, profile) with its states. Record the redesign as a new ADR.
- **replan-project** by @Shivam-Fl (2026-10-05T17:32:45.640Z):
  Reviewed: the design system in #32 is approved as written — keep docs/ui.md, the screen structures, the component specs, the tokens and lucide-react exactly as they are, and keep every other decision unchanged. Two things in #32 came from the framework, which is now fixed: it re-recorded the eight existing decisions as ADR-0009 to ADR-0016, and it dropped the 'Added by review and QA' section of conventions.md. Regenerate the brief so the PR carries only the one new ADR for the redesign and keeps the learned conventions. In the brief, give each decision you keep its original title without an ADR number, so it is recognised as already recorded.
- **replan-project** by @Shivam-Fl (2026-10-05T17:45:31.201Z):
  Same as the last request: keep docs/ui.md and every decision exactly as they are; regenerate only, now that the framework also recognises a recorded decision by the title in its ADR heading, so the success-notices decision is not recorded twice.

review.title: A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.
review.detail:
A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.

`components/groups-panels.tsx`

Evidence: leaveGroup returns the same NonZeroBalanceError sentence as removeMember (lib/groups/actions.ts:405 vs :355), but MembersPanel renders only `<StateMessage state={leaveState} />` (components/groups-panels.tsx:707) with no isBalanceBlockedRefusal check, while RemoveMemberForm checks it (:468) and renders the Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading (:491; anchor exists at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:320). Repro: carry a balance, press Leave group and confirm: the refusal names the blocker with no way onward.

Fix: Mirror the remove path beside leaveState: const leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) and render the same Settle up link when true.

review.title: An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.
review.detail:
An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.

`app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx`

Evidence: SoloOwnerAction returns null when group.archived (app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:234), so the EmptyState renders with no action, yet its body (:191) still says 'Share the invite link and the rest can join — or add somebody by name below if they have not signed up'. Archived groups refuse join/rotate/disable writes (ARCHIVED_STATE in lib/groups/actions.ts) and the same screen says seats cannot be added (:200), so both suggested actions fail and the read-only wording AC-2 requires is not what the empty state says.

Fix: When group.archived, give the solo-owner EmptyState read-only copy instead of the invite-sharing sentence (or suppress the EmptyState for archived groups, since the seats note already covers it).
